segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, first page's oracle entry) to the Oracle. Its Lua runs des.room with xalign and yalign "center" and a contents callback that places fountains with the positional des.feature form, des.stair, and des.random_corridors, through lspo_room, sel_set_feature, l_create_stairway, and lspo_random_corridors. No recording yet: with this seed the level lies at difficulty 9, and its recording diverges in mklev.c dosdoor(), whose trapped-door mimic branch (makemon(mkclass(S_MIMIC, 0)) under level_difficulty() >= 9) the port lacks; record it once that function lands.
